capabilities: Start short, long, or custom-length writing sessions from the command palette
Delete in-session text after five seconds of inactivity, with a two-second warning
Show a progress bar for the running session
Configure default session durations in settings
extras: The README warns that unsuccessful sessions irrevocably delete in-session work, and marks the plugin as experimental with bug reports welcome.
intentEvidence: Emulates Manu Ebert's excellent The Most Dangerous Writing App.
motivation: The author wanted to emulate Manu Ebert's The Most Dangerous Writing App inside Obsidian.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to force continuous writing by penalizing pauses with the loss of in-session text.

relations.evidence: Inspired by Manu Ebert's The Most Dangerous Writing App.

summary: Timed free-writing plugin that deletes everything written in a session if you stop typing for five seconds.
